request: Create a board-ready Word expansion brief for Meridian Clinics, a fictional outpatient healthcare group, evaluating opening two new clinics over 12 months. Audience: the board and operations director. Compare phased launch versus simultaneous launch, recommend one approach, and include an executive summary, decision criteria, staffing and ownership, quarterly rollout milestones, an itemized illustrative capital and operating budget with totals capped at USD 600,000, a scenario table covering base, optimistic, and stressed cases, a risk register with owners and mitigations, and KPI dashboard definitions. Provide at least three tables and an assumptions/limitations appendix. Treat all patients, costs, volumes, dates, organizations, and metrics as explicit mock data. Label regulatory and privacy considerations as general, unverified planning prompts, not legal or medical advice. Do not invent citations, claim external research, or imply facts have been verified. State unresolved questions and decisions requiring human validation. Keep the document internally consistent and include a clear recommendation.
